name: Staff of the Storyteller
oracle_text:
When this artifact enters, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
Whenever you create one or more creature tokens, put a story counter on this artifact.
{W}, {T}, Remove a story counter from this artifact: Draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you create one or more creature tokens, put a story counter on this artifact.

needs.what: a token_created trigger honouring `batched: true`, so "whenever you create one or more creature tokens" fires once per simultaneous creation rather than once per token
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_created with a Creature filter exists, but primitives.create_token fires TOKEN_CREATED without the `batch` field that triggers._queue reads, so `batched` is silently ignored and making three tokens at once would add three counters; batched permanent_enters with is_token is the documented near miss (reads the entering permanent's controller, not the creator)
